# Less work each frame, fix/perf135 (1280x720; the demo song, which has no cover, so the bar shows its round space for
# the cover with the note in it; paused on a line so the equaliser rests and the pictures hold still; noon, clear).
# The branch draws the round shapes (the bar's pill and border, the equaliser and signal bars, the round space for the
# cover, the progress line, the Record card's record and its round ends) from fewer pieces, the bar's note once per
# language, and the World, Lines and Arc words with kept styles. Nothing may look different: compare each picture with
# the old code's, pixel for pixel round the bar, the card and the words. Look hardest at the round ends of the pill and
# its border, the four equaliser dots and the four signal bars right of the clock, the circle round the note, and the
# record's rings on the card: no line across the middle of a round end, no missing or doubled row or column, the same
# smooth edge.
# Run it on the branch, and with -f mod_ref=77442fb3 (land/batch101, the code before the branch) for the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/perf135 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/perf135.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/perf135 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=77442fb3 -f script=.github/checks/perf135.txt
# (and the same two with -f version=1.21.1, whose GUI draws each piece at once instead of collecting them).
#
# 1. perf135-bar-gui3 / -gui2 / -gui4: the top bar at GUI scale 3, 2 and 4 (at 3 the pill is an even number of pixels
#    tall, so its ends are drawn as two half discs; at 2 and 4 it is odd and drawn as before). The equaliser rests as
#    four round dots, the signal bars stand in four heights.
# 2. perf135-bar-progress-gui3: Song progress on, a thin round-ended line under the words.
# 3. perf135-card-gui3 / -gui2: the Record card, bottom right, its record's rings.
# 4. perf135-lines / perf135-arc: the Lines and the Arc layout, Glow 0.5 and Two-tone on, still paused on the line:
#    the same letters, colours, glow and depth as the old code's.
# 5. perf135-bar-playing: playing again, the World layout: the equaliser bars hop (their heights differ from run to
#    run; only look that their ends are round), and the World words round the crosshair are drawn as on the old code.

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
look 0 -20
guiscale 3
sleep 8

# 1: the bar, paused on a line, at GUI scale 3, 2 and 4
music pause
sleep 1
seek 25.5
sleep 2
where
shot perf135-bar-gui3
guiscale 2
sleep 2
shot perf135-bar-gui2
guiscale 4
sleep 2
shot perf135-bar-gui4
guiscale 3
sleep 1

# 2: with the progress line
set barProgress true
sleep 2
shot perf135-bar-progress-gui3
set barProgress false
sleep 1

# 3: the Record card
set recordCard true
set cardCorner BOTTOM_RIGHT
sleep 2
shot perf135-card-gui3
guiscale 2
sleep 2
shot perf135-card-gui2
guiscale 3
set recordCard false
sleep 1

# 4: the Lines and the Arc layout, with glow and two tones, still paused
set glow 0.5
set twoTone true
set layout LINES
sleep 2
shot perf135-lines
set layout ARC
sleep 2
shot perf135-arc
set layout WORLD
set glow 0
set twoTone false
sleep 1

# 5: playing again
music play
sleep 1.5
where
shot perf135-bar-playing
